cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Would you sell your signed guitar so we can replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then let's price it properly. Those hours should buy us an ice maker.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case. You can still tell the queue story while I photograph the guitar.

mechanism: A uses valuation and presentation corrections to persuade B to sell a signed guitar while preserving the less valuable case as the sentimental substitute.
confusable: Generic bargaining lacks a technically grounded correction of what creates sale value and how it should be shown.
comparison: Medal alternative uses public provenance; guitar alternative separates signature value from a keepsake container.
seedUse: Guitar/fridge seed supplies queue effort and case offer; S03 should correct the valuation of the offered substitute rather than just reject it.
